purpose: Mark an outcome reached after a long period or repeated developments.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
After years of practice, I finally won the championship.
I finally found the book I had been looking for.
restrictions: Can introduce a welcome achievement or an unwelcome final outcome.
mistake: とうとう is similar; ついに does not inherently mean success.
